overallFinding.summary: Bybit EU GmbH has a direct Austrian FMA MiCAR CASP authorisation for core crypto-asset services and Bybit EU publishes a dedicated EEA platform for eligible residents. Current Poland-facing evidence includes PLN/BLIK deposits and PLN trading pairs. Product availability is explicitly country/product dependent, so the appropriate draft Poland posture is AVAILABLE_WITH_LIMITS for core regulated services rather than blanket availability.
overallFinding.recommendation: Treat core Bybit EU crypto-asset exchange/custody/transfer services for Poland as a candidate AVAILABLE_WITH_LIMITS research posture, subject to MarketProfile review and exact product evidence. KYC is mandatory. Keep PLN withdrawal, Earn, Card, derivatives and CBW referral/bonus binding separately under review or not verified as documented.

methodologyNotes: No login, account creation, registration attempt, KYC submission, payment, deposit, withdrawal, trade or referral submission was performed.
FMA regulator evidence was kept distinct from Bybit EU self-disclosures and Poland marketing/product surfaces.
MiCAR authorisation was not used as authority for unregulated or separately gated products such as Earn or derivatives.
Historical promotions were explicitly dated and not promoted to current offers.
The global CBW owner-confirmed Bybit partner URL/code was not treated as Bybit EU Poland campaign eligibility evidence.
